card.name: Capital first letter starting a new term
card.fires_on: The first letter or first piece of a capitalized word that begins a new term in drug labels, such as a brand name, table row label, or heading. It fires right after a space-less join such as 'and', 'receiving', or a list item.

modes.label: Brand name starts
modes.description: The first letter J of a brand name like JESDUVROQ or JUXTAPID after a clause.

modes.label: Table row labels
modes.description: The start of an organ or test row label in a table, such as Bladder or Bilirubin.

modes.label: Heading words
modes.description: The first letter of a capitalized word in a table title or heading, such as Volumes.
